historical_cohort.note: The 100-trade cohort predates mandatory strategy_fingerprint persistence. It must remain the control cohort and must not be relabeled as generated by the current executable fingerprint.

parity_fixes: gate_snapshot now labels ADX as adx_context because ADX thresholds were not part of the current signal_mask execution predicate.
analyze_latest now derives execution from signal_mask() first and applies the optional failure shield only afterward.
failure shield is disabled by default, preserving the original V15 control behavior.
next_cohort_requirements: Every executable trade must contain strategy_fingerprint.
Every executable trade must contain execution_parity and failure_shield diagnostics.
No optimization parameter may be changed during the locked validation cohort.
The 100-trade holdout remains historical control data.
